Dialogs.Dialog: Are you staying here？ Come on, let's go.
Ah, over here, over here. Don't walk past it, okay？
Ah, we have arrived. Time sure flies...
It's a shame, but we should wrap up soon... right.
Yeah. Let's call it here, then.
I guess that's it for today？ Hehe, I want to stay together a little longer, though.
Shall we call it a day here？
Yeah. See you next time, then.
About time for today... I guess？
Yeah. Let's call it a day here, then.
Shall we stop here for today？
Where are we going？ I'd be happy if you decide...
Okay, where would you like to go？
Hehe. Hey, where shall we go？
Where do you want to go？
Hehe. Anywhere you want to go next？
Hehe. So, where are you taking me next？
No matter where we go, it's fun when we are together.
Where to next？ Okay, decide before I count to three.
Want to go somewhere else too？
I'd like you to decide what we watch...
Hehe. Today, pick a movie you like.
What are we watching today？ Anything's fine with me, as long as I'm watching it with you.
Is there... something you want to see？
Which movie do you think I want to see？
No need to rush, let's pick one that looks good？
A movie... huh. Ah, no, it's not that I don't want to see one...
Just pick anything. But it has to be good.
You know, right？ Pick a movie that'll get us excited, okay？
Hey, want to see another one？
Hmm... a perceptive boyfriend would watch the other one with me too, right？
Hehe. Since we're here, want to see another？
...Hey. Since we're here, the other one too...
If I said I wanted to see another one, what would you do？
What do you think？ Since we're here, want to see another？
Hmm, should I... hehe, kidding, kidding.
Um... ah, no. If you're okay with it...
I see. I'm not really in the mood, but...
I'd have been fine with... something else, maybe？
Ah, shall we have lunch soon？
It's almost lunchtime, got anything in mind？
Hehe. I'm getting hungry, want to have lunch？
It's almost lunchtime... what should we do？
Hey. What time do you think it is？
Hey. Want to... get some tea somewhere？
Then, want to go into a cafe or something？
I'm a little tired. Shall we have some tea？
Want to get some tea somewhere？
...When a girl gets a little tired, what should her boyfriend do？
Aren't you hungry？ I think it's about dinnertime...
Okay, what time is it now？
Hey, aren't you hungry？ If you want, let's have dinner somewhere.
If you want... shall we have dinner somewhere？
It's already this late, shall we have dinner？
Hehe, we're here. I wonder what I'll order...
Ah, here？ ...Hehe. No need to rush, the restaurant won't run away.
I want to be with you a little longer... can't I？
I want to enjoy our time together... a little longer.
Hehe. You know by now, right？
Want to go have fun somewhere else too？
Of course. Then where shall we go？
Um... I want to be with you a little longer, is that... okay？
Hmm, should I... hehe, sure. Let's go.
Let's try going somewhere else too.
Hehe, that's how it should be.
Yeah. Let's stay together a bit longer？
Ah... sorry. I want to stay with you, but time...
Hmm... it'd have been nice if we had a little more time.
Too bad, but time's up. Time really flies, huh.
Um... can we call it off after all？
Hmm... I'll pass on that after all. Next time, okay？
Sorry. Can we skip it today after all...？
